name: dmengine-fumo-update-no-result
description: Mode C combined FUMO no-result path: DownloadAndUpdate completes the DD/DP download and hands event 77 to the OEM handler, but the lab OEM handler sends no update result. The engine stays in update progressing and never sets success state 90; no update report is issued. The result is deliberately withheld; no physical install is claimed.
